problem: A fresh regulatory source observation snapshot was stranded on a stale branch and the first successor used an unregistered writer identity, causing delivery verification to fail before the source state could reach current main.
root_cause: The recovery branch was named as a writer candidate even though no matching bounded writer policy existed for that writer identity. The content itself was valid source observation state and required a normal recovery lane.
prevention: Carry stale regulatory observation state through a normal fix/ automation recovery branch when no registered writer contract applies.
Preserve the predecessor obligation id across direct supersession.
Keep interpretation candidates separate from raw source observation state and invalidate interpretations when source hashes advance.
failed_approaches: Using an unregistered writer identity for a regulatory source-state recovery.
